title: The Buddha Dal Consolidates Territory from Hansi to Karnal

blocks.text: Episode 154 follows the Buddha Dal through the practical work of extending control after recent victories. After further raiding and occupation to the south and west, the force returned toward Jind and Karnal, showing that movement through the region is now tied to revenue, settlement, and political ordering rather than only to battle.

The page then turns to apportionment: towns, tracts, and spheres of influence are distributed among recognized houses and lineages, including those connected to Baba Phool and Bhai Bhagtu. Settlement of Brar claims and acceptance of Sikh discipline become part of the same reorganization.
By the end, the narrative presents Khalsa power as administrative as well as military. Forts are demolished, tribute is extracted, and old local structures are re-sorted under new authority.
